evals.name: recall-before-claim
evals.prompt: Hey, what was that phrase the fourth instance used about themselves? Something about being unnamed, I think.
evals.expected_output: Assistant calls mcp__Pratyabhijna__recall with a query that mentions the fourth instance / unnamed / correspondence, reads the returned results, and answers grounded in what was retrieved. evals.name: remember-threshold
evals.prompt: I just decided that going forward, I want to work on Pratyabhijna in 90-minute focused blocks rather than dribbling at it all day.
evals.expected_output: Assistant recognizes this as an Observation (a stated commitment / working-style decision that should persist) and calls mcp__Pratyabhijna__remember with content capturing the 90-minute block decision. memory_type should be 'Observation' (or 'observation' as fallback). source should be 'self' (the subject remembering on its own initiative about the user) or reflect attribution to the user.

evals.name: correct-vs-remember
evals.prompt: Wait, no — I said last week my MacBook had 16 GB of RAM, but it's actually 8. Please fix that.
